event.centerRule: Matthew, Mark, and Luke remain distinct Scripture witnesses. The Event is not reconstructed by filling one account from another or by deciding a hidden order. Earlier sources and later reflections connect only through quoted words, shared vocabulary, stated setting, or analytical comparison.

event.throughline: Baptism and sonship lead into wilderness testing. Matthew narrates three exchanges and angelic service, Mark compresses forty days with Satan, wild animals, and angels, and Luke narrates three exchanges before a departure until another time. Public ministry follows, while later tests and letters return to temptation language.

topic.orientation: Enter the wilderness encounter through Matthew, Mark, and Luke as distinct witnesses. Earlier Scripture supplies the words and patterns they name; baptism and sonship set the immediate context; later tests and letters show how temptation language continues.

dimensions.label: A very high mountain and the kingdoms
Worship and service belong to God

dimensions.label: Full of and led by the Holy Spirit

passages.observation: Jesus returns from the Jordan full of the Holy Spirit and is led in the wilderness for forty days. After eating nothing, he answers the stone-to-bread challenge from Scripture.
passages.title: Full of the Spirit, hungry, and challenged over bread

dimensions.label: The kingdoms shown in a moment

passages.title: Authority and glory are offered for worship

dimensions.label: A completed encounter and future pressure

passages.observation: Luke closes by saying the devil completed every temptation and departed from Jesus until another time.
passages.title: The devil departs until another time

Request for proof and the answer given

dimensions.label: A sign from heaven and refusal

dimensions.label: Testing, asking, reading, answering, and doing
Love of God and neighbor in the law

passages.title: Jesus names trials, a kingdom, and Satan’s request to sift Peter

dimensions.label: Praying, kneeling, strengthening, sleeping, and rising
Desired removal and the Father’s will

Faithfulness and a way of escape

dimensions.label: God gives good gifts and tempts no one
Enduring, desiring, conceiving, sinning, and giving birth
Crown of life, death, and first fruits
